subject: tr-info
title: TR.INFO.------T.C.IMP.
description: Chart on book p. 33 (BK(NM)-9). TR-INFO (trans-information) is the subject; T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is the partner. From the subject: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics), SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and SG-CULT-SOLD, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From AFL-DY: INFO-TRNS (information transference). From SPT-DY: AFI (affinity insight). From SG-CULT-SOLD: TH-ALGN (thrust alignment), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From INFO-TRNS: POST (postulation). From AFI: ATTN (attraction). From TH-ALGN: RE-DOC (redocumentation). From RE-DOC: POL-DYM (political dynamics). From POL-DYM: INFO-COMP (information compression).
